question: how do the verified endpoint numbers change once the corrected verdict record is used

reproduction_check_first.purpose: the recomputation was validated against the recorded numbers before the corrected record was used

defect_found_in_the_recomputation.issue: the first recomputation applied the multiplier to the standard error of a condition mean rather than to the standard error of the paired difference, giving 0.0571 against the recorded 0.0808
defect_found_in_the_recomputation.resolution: the recorded value is correct: a paired difference of two condition means carries a factor of the square root of two, and adding it reproduced the recorded number exactly
defect_found_in_the_recomputation.lesson: the discrepancy was in the check, not in the record, and was resolved by deriving the quantity rather than by trusting either number

what_changed: the task share of variance rose from 16.2 to 21.5 percent and the residual fell from 83.8 to 78.5 percent
the condition and interaction components remain exactly zero, so the structural conclusion that the standard error is independent of how the budget is split between tasks and repeats is unchanged
the paired minimum detectable effect moved from 0.0808 to 0.0825
the correlation between the falsified cue endpoint and the verified endpoint fell from 0.043 to 0.018, so the two endpoints remain close to unrelated
what_did_not_change: no conclusion in the paper depends on the difference; the endpoint remains inadmissible for scoring until human labels exist
claim_scope: recomputation only; no treatment effect is claimed
